༄༅/ /dben khrod ljon pa lung gi bca' yig blang dor gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dben khrod ljon pa lung gi bca' yig blang dor gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

oṃ swa sti/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa// sangs rgyas padma rnam rgyas 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba// de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis dang po'o// de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab g.yo med pa// 'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa// chos kyi dam pa skye rgu rnams la zhi byed pa// de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa'o// dam chos ldan pa thos pa'i bkra shis kyis phyug cing*// dge 'dun mi dang lha dang lha min yon gyi gnas// tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi// 'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa'o// de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhal nas gsungs pa'i bkra shis kyi tshig gis mdun bsus te/ da lam shing pho khyi yi lo 'dir dben khrod ljon pa lung gi dgon gnas gsar btab 'dir bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun pa'i mtshan gyi grwa yig zur gsal ltar la/ da res kyi skabs su/ dus su babs pa'i char/ skabs su babs pa'i gtam/ gna' rabs dang bstun pa'i lo rgyus/ da rabs dang sbyar ba'i nyams dga'/ phyis 'byung du 'chang rgyu'i bca' bkod gsum gyi rnam gzhag gi dbang du byas nas thog mtha' bar gsum dang 'brel ba'i 'dus sde lhan rgyas nas khas blangs kyi gtan tshigs kyi ri mo mi 'gyur ba'i don rtsa bzhin/ rtsa ba'i dang po/ sngon rabs kyi lo rgyus 'di la spyir yas gtam dam pa chos kyi 'byung khungs*/ mas gtam srid pa'i chags 'byung gru bzhi gnyis pau de rgyas par 'chad 'os che na'ang*/ 'dir mdo bsdus su bshad na/ ston pa sangs rgyas kyi byon tshul/ bstan pa dam chos kyi dar tshul/ bstan 'dzin dge 'dun gyi sde byon tshul/ steng na rje yi gdung rabs/ 'og na 'bangs kyi mi rabs/ dbu nag bod kyi chags tshul/ dar gos chen gyi dri la kha phye ba lta bu/ nyams gcig gis mi mang po ngo mtshar mi rgyud re re nas 'thon na mnyan rgyu re re yod pa dri za'i rol mo 'dra 'dra/

gtam zhim mngar lha yi bdud rtsi 'thung ba 'dra ba rgyas par bshad na bshad rgyu los yod de/ skabs 'dir dgos rgyu dam pa'i lha chos yin pas/ de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i gtam nyung bsdus zhig bshad na/ de yang gsang chen thabs la mkhas pa'i mdo las/ dpa' bo chen po thabs mkhas te// sems can yongs su smin mdzad phyir// bye ba phrag brgyar rgyal ba nyid// sangs rgyas nyid du bstan gyur kyang*// da dung du yang 'dren pa khyod// sangs rgyas mang po ston pa mdzad// ces gsungs pa ltar bcom ldan 'das dpal kun tu bzang po nyid ye sangs rgyas kyang yang sangs rgyas pa'i tshul du ston nas/ khams gsum gyi mun sel bskal bzang rnam 'dren bzhi pa dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa des/ stong gsum mi 'jed kyi 'jig rten gling bzhi bye ba phrag brgya na/ spel legs kyi tshom bu bkra ba lta bu'i nang nas gling khyad par du 'phags pa lho rgyal 'dzam bu'i gling gi dbus/ mi 'jig rdo rje'i gdan byang chub snying po'i shing gi drung du bla na med pa'i ye shes rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mngon du mdzad/ spyir mdzad pa bcu gnyis/ sgos dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum du bskor/ dus thog ma nyid du yul wā rā ṇa sīr sham thabs zlum por bsgo bar bya'o tshun chad kyis sna drangs/ spyir bden pa bzhi yi chos 'khor dang*/ bye brag yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi ma/ dus thog ma nyid du mi rgod po'i shes rgyud gdams ngag gis 'dul ba la ming dang don mthun pa'i chos 'dul ba'i bslab khrims gsungs/ rigs can gyi gdul bya smin grol bkod/ rigs med kyi sems can dge bcu'i khrims kyis bsdus/ sangs rgyas kyi phrin las tshad bzung du med par mdzad de gzugs sku chos kyi dbyings su thim pa'i 'og tu/ slar yang ye shes sgyu ma'i rnam rol dri med dha na ko sha'i mtsho gling*/ dag gtsang padmo'i sbubs nas sangs rgyas gnyis pa o rgyan padma'i skur bzhengs nas ji srid nam mkha' ma zad kyi bar du gdul bya mtha' med pa la/

thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i khrims bsdam/ 'byung ba mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad bka' rtags phyag rgya'i zil 'og tu bcug phan bde 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gzhir bzhengs su bslangs/ gzhan yang rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du bstan pa'i gtad rabs bdun/ 'dzam gling rgyan drug mchog gnyis/ grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi sogs mkhas grub kyi phreng ba brgyud mar byon pa rnams kyis gnas gzhi gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ der bzhugs dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ nyams len sdom pa gsum gyi rnam gzhag lung sde snod gsum gyi 'chad nyan/ dge 'dun gyi bya ba che phra kun kyang gros thog sde snod dang rgyud sde la gtug gros thag 'du ba 'dzin pas bcad rgyu'i khrims srol yod pas de ga'i rjes su 'brang dgos rgyu gzhir bcas/ de nas bsil ldan gyi ljongs bod yul 'dir/ gnam lha babs kyi rgyal po/ sa lhun grub kyi mnga' bdag mgo nag mi yi rje bo rigs gsum sprul pa'i sku chos rgyal mes dbon gsum gyi sku ring la/ rgyal khrims gser gyi gnya' shing lci la sbram pa gcig dang*/ chos khrims dar gyi mdud pa dam la 'jam pa gcig byung bas 'di phyi gnyis gar bde ba'i gzhi btsugs/ de'i nang nas kyang 'phags chen khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sku ring la mkhan slob nyi zla zung gcig rgya gar 'phags yul nas spyan drangs/ spyir mchod gnas sde gnyis btsugs/ de'i nang nas kyang mkha' chen thams cad mkhyen pa zhi ba 'tshos bstan pa'i rtsa ba 'dul 'dzin ngur smrig gi sde la shrī na lend+ra yi phyag bzhes rnam gzhag zhal chems su btab/ lha chos kyi sgrigs lam gtsang ba'i ched du mkhan chen byang chub sems dpa' bho dhi sa twa'i zhal gdams dang*/ gu ru rin po ches yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i zhal gdams yon tan gter mdzod/ bod khams bde thabs kyi chos bcu sogs mdzad/ mnga' bdag rgyal pos bkas bcad kyi khrims rgya chen po nyi ma shar ba 'dra ba gcig byung ba red/

de'i rjes su bstan pa phyi dar gyi thog ma za hor mkhan chen bho dhi sa twa'i dbon rabs bcu bdun pa mnyam med jo bo rje a ti sha bod yul du gdan drangs nas chos khrims kyi rnam gzhag nyams med gsar du sdom par mdzad nas bzung bka' gdams/ bka' brgyud/ sa skya/ dge ldan/ bo dong pa/ jo nang*/ zhwa lu sogs kyi grwa pa/ gsang bde gung gsum/ dga' skyo zur gsum/ gdan sa mthil/ dwags lha sgam po/ 'bri gung*/ stag lung*/ 'brug pa/ tshal pa/ sa ngor gtsang gsum/ se 'bras dga' gsum sogs na bca' yig glegs bam gyi khur long ba mang po yod pas de dag thams cad bshad na zad rgyu ci yod/ dgos rang skal gsang sngags snga 'gyur rnying ma ba'i mdo sgyu sems gsum gyi rang lugs dang 'brel ba'i sgrub gzhung chog khrigs cho ga chos spyod/ gar dbyangs thig gsum/ bca' 'bud brdung gsum/ byon bzhugs gsol lugs kyi sgrigs lam phra mo tshun chad khungs thub phyag bzhes gtsang ma yid ches mkhan/ rjes 'jug gi skyes bu sgrub phrin gyi phyag bzhes la byang mkhan/ mthong tshad kyi blo sna chos la 'gyur mkhan/ mos gus sems rgyud byin rlabs kyis smin mkhan/ bka' babs kyi chu bo bzhi ni rgyun ma chad pa zhig gsang sngags kyi rgyal po so zur gnubs gsum la bka' babs te gdan sa chen po 'ug pa lugs dang*/ brag rgya bo/ shangs mda' dpal chen lha khang sogs su sngar shin tu dar rgyas che bar byung*/ bar du rgyal bstan me ro smad nas gso ba'i lung bstan bzhin du bstan pa'i nyi ma chen po bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal mkhan brgyud las/ bod chen po mdo khams kyi shar phyogs 'bri rdza zal mo sgang gi sa yi cha 'dir/ bod rgyal po spu rang tse sde dang smad gling ge sar rgyal po'i tshe smad du kun mkhyen bla ma shar kaḥthog pa chen po dam pa bde bar gshegs pa shes rab seng ges rab byung gnyis pa'i sa mo yos kyi lor dpal kaḥthog gi chos grwa btab nas/

da lo shing pho khyi lo 'di phan chad mi lo bdun brgya dang bdun cu rtsa lnga po/ de'i ring la chos rje dam gtsang byams gsum/ lung bstan bu bzhi/ bla rabs bcu gsum/ drung rabs bcu gsum/ grub pa'i dbang phyug rmog rabs bcu gsum sogs 'chad nyan mkhan brgyud man ngag don brgyud rnams kyi sku ring la phyag len 'dul ba la gzhi bzung*/ dge 'dun 'bum phrag bco brgyad 'dus/ gso sbyong gi dus chos gos kyi mdangs kyis nam mkha' dmar ser du bsgyur/ thugs dam mdo sgyu sems gsum la mdzad/ gdul bya khyab brdal dang*/ 'chad nyan ris med du bskyang*/ mdo dbus gtsang gsum du snyan grags ngang gis khyab/ bkra shis dam pa'i gdugs dkar po'i bsil grib du rang ris gdul bya rnams chub par mdzad/ dben ri dang sgrub gnas phal cher rtogs ldan dang grub thob kyis bkang*/ 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sgo 'phar phyes/ rmad du byung ba'i mkhas pa du ma bskrun/ dam pa'i chos 'chad nyan sgom gsum gyis dga' ston bkyes/ phyi tshul khrims dag cing lung rigs mkhas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rnam thar gtsang/ gsang sngags bskyed rdzogs kyi don la rang byan tshud/ sa chen po la bzhugs pa'i rnam thar ma sbas sgrib med du gsal zhing phyag rjes rgya chen po gzur gnas ris med kyi mkhas pa kun la rlung ltar du grags pa 'di red/ dpe der mtshungs gi sprul pa'i gter ston chen po o rgyan padma'i rgyal tshab mnga' bdag nyang dang*/ gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug gter kha gong 'og rtsa ba/ yan lag ratna gling pa/ padma gling pa sogs lho gter gyi rgyun dang phyag bzhes las/ dbu ru lho rgyud rig 'dzin gter bdag gling pa yab sras kyi o rgyan smin grol gling gi gdan sa/ byang ba gter chen po rig 'dzin rgod kyi ldem 'phru can dang*/ chos rgyal mnga' ris paṇa chen sku mched/ byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal sogs kyi chos rgyun phyag bzhes las thub bstan rdo rje brag gi gdan sa gnyis su sgrigs lam gyi rgyun bzhag pa la bod kyi sa cha stod smad gang du'ang*/

deng sang gi bar du grwa pa rdor smin gnyis kyi phyag bzhes zer nas yar bltas zhwa 'phen gyi yul yin pa kun gyi shes gsal ltar lags/ sngon mdo khams chen po gling gis bzung ba'i yul 'dir/ dpal sa skya ba chen po 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa/ stobs kyis 'khor los bsgyur ba hor gong ma so chen gnam gyi rgyal pos gdan drangs/ gong ma mchod yon du 'brel/ gong ma chen po'i sku mched chung ba de phebs pa'i gdung rigs las byon pa hor gyi gdung rabs rim byon gyi/ mnga' bdag sa skyong rgyal po hor khang gsar gyi mnga' khul du/ rgyal bstan ris med dgon khag grangs ma mchis pa zhig bzhugs pa las rang re sngar nas kaḥthog gi chos brgyud 'dzin pa'i gras su gtogs pa lags/ ༈ da rtsa ba'i gnyis pa da rabs dang sbyar nas nyams dga' cung zad spro na/ grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po rmog grub nam mkha' chos dbang gi lung byang las/ sbal sbrul gnyis kyi rdo rje rgya gram rtsod// ngag gi ming can shar gyi phyogs nas 'byung*// 'od kyi me long lag mthil tsam zhig la// ma chags kaḥthog gnas su gnas bcas na// sku tshe mdzad pa mtha' ru rgyas pa 'byung*// zhes dang*/ rdzogs sprul bzhi pa mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rdo rje gnas 'di nyid du phebs nas zhag gcig gi bar du sgar phab nas bzhugs/ phyi nyin 'di phyogs gi gzhi bdag phal cher gnas pa'i ri rnams kyi ming spos mdzad/ phyin chad 'di nas dgon gnas gsar du chags pa'i lung bstan gnang*/ bdag cag gi dpal mgon bla ma dam pas sku tshe'i smad tsam du rang re'i dgon pa zhig btab dgos pa'i zhal bkod gnang*/ khyad par du rje thams cad mkhyen pa si tu rin po che chos kyi rgya mtshos kaḥthog rgyud sde'i bshad sgrub kyi dbu 'dzug pa dang mnyam du ri khrod 'di nas dgon pa gsar btab dgos pa'i lung bstan bzhin/ 7mnga' bdag sa skyong rgyal po hor khang gsar sras po'i mdun snyan sgron zhu ba phul nas dgongs khrol thob pa bzhin/

chu phag gi lo mgo na sa bzung*/ gtsug lag khang rten brten pa dang bcas pa gsar bzhengs btsugs pa lags pas/ bstan pa 'chi med kyi bdud rtsi 'gro ba lha dang bcas pa'i bsod nams g.yang gi kha phor du da dung yun ring por 'khyil rgyu'i blo gtad yod pas/ spyir bstan pa'i zhabs zhu/ dgos rang gi 'di phyi'i rang chas su gzhi sdom pa gsum gyi spang blang tshul khrims rnam par dag pa zhig la 'bad pa zhig dang*/ lhag par 'og nas 'byung 'gyur gyi rtsa bzhi chang lnga'i nyes pas ma gos pa zhig dang*/ rang 'khos dang bstun pa'i thos bsam slob gnyer la brtson pa zhig dang*/ so byang sngags gsum gyi nyams len ci nus su yod pa zhig rnal 'byor rang bca'/ ba rnga rang lcag skam po rang 'bar/ mkhas pa rang shes/ rang don rang gal che ba dgos pa dang*/ dad ldan dang ba 'dren pa'i mig rgyan/ 'byor ldan bsod nams bsags pa'i zhing sa yin pas/ rgyal ba'i bka' las/ shing phran stong gi dbus na tsanda gyi sdong po zhig khyad par 'phags pa bzhin du/ khyim gnas stong gi dbus na ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan thogs pa gcig gi kun spyod phra mo gcig gis khyad par du 'phags dgos par gsungs ba bzhin du ston pa'i rjes 'jug 'dren pa dge 'dun pa yin pas thugs la bzhag dgos rgyu yin lags/ ༈ da rtsa ba'i gsum pa phyis 'byung du thugs la 'chang rgyu'i bca' bkod la don tshan dang po/ bla ma grwa pa lhan rgyas nas mang blo 'gyod med/ mang kha brjod med kyis gros thag gcig bcad kyis don tshan lnga yi khas dan gyi yi ge bzhag don ltar/ phyi khang tshag nang grwa tshag gi thad nas/ sngar kha shas re khang pa grub zin kyang*/ snga ma cha shas las nas da bar mi lo nyi shu rtsa lnga tsam song bar da dung phal cher khang pa med rgyu'i thad nas/ kha sa lag mas zhan stabs kyi nyams gzigs yin rgyu'i/ mi dbul po grwa gsum re dang*/ 'bring gnyis re/ rab mi re khang pa sa rdo shing gsum gang rung re'i khang pa 'grub nges dgos rgyu dang*/

khyad par du gyur pa grwa tshag gi thad phyogs nas/ sngon yar dpe zhwa la 'gran chog pa bla ma grwa pa bzang po phal cher zhig yod kyang*/ bar skabs zhig nas rkang pa gnyis btsugs gis mig ltos ngan pa'i dmigs rkyen gyis bstan pa'i rkang 'dren du song*/ shes med rnams pho hob dang*/ chog bzod byas shing khyim pa 'dra ba kho nar song dus/ nged rang nas rang mkhos dang bstun pa'i bsgo lag go bskon mang du byas kyang nyan rgyu shes rgyu med pa 'di bzhin la/ da lam rtsa bcad kyi ngan pa phyi lam chod pa'i nyes pa drag po zhig la gtug na 'os 'brel yod/ kaḥdapal rdzogs gsum gtsos bla ma dgon pa'i 'gro lugs re yod pa shes kyang shes/ thub kyang thub na yang de nas da dung bla ma slob ma yin khul gyis rgyu lus gnyis thog gi chad pa btang snyoms su byas/ da phyin dgos pa'i so nam la lo khang 'di'i sos thog tshun chad du/ bco brgyad nas drug cu'i bar gyi grwa ba rnams thugs bsam gzhig 'brel zhib btang gi sgo nas/ yar grwa ba nges ngag zhig byed na/ dgos rgyu dod rgyu de yin pas los chog steng*/ mar khyim pa byed na byed shag gi skya ser shan phyes shag chod pa byed rgyu khas dan ltar la/ de phyin chad nas ngan pa lang shor gyis rkang pa gnyis btsug gis 'dug mi chog rgyu dang*/ gal srid de 'dra byed mi yod na btang snyoms su bzhag pas mi 'thus pas/ lus thog gi rta lcag lnga brgya/ rgyu thog nas dngul srang bcu gnyis zhu ngo sgron med du sgrub dgos thog khyim pa yin thag chod pa byed rgyu thams cad khas dan ltar sems bzhag dgos thog 'gal ba spu tsam mi chog de dus bka' khrims la rag las pa las med pa thams cad kyis go bar gyis/ don tshan gnyis pa dus rgyun par bzhugs rgyu'i thad nas/ rang re'i kha rje gyis rgyun bzhugs mthar 'khyol ba dka' bas/ dbyar gnas lo bstar gyis bzhugs rgyu la/ dge tshul slong sum cu tsam kha long na phyed phyed kyis lo res mos bzhugs rgyu dang*/

chos zhu med dus dang*/ nged yar mar du 'gro skabs sogs dus skabs bde gzar gyis sngar rgyun bzhin dud re'i ser re 'dug ris grangs mang nyung tshod bltas kyi bzhugs rgyu dang*/ bzhugs mi rnams rkyen ngan mthong gsal yod na dgongs khrol dang*/ de min par ngan g.yo khong sran gyis mi 'ong na ṭam gnyis kyi chad pa bcad mis bcad dgos/ sgrub mis sgrub dgos/ der ma ltos par rang bsam gyis zla shas su rang don du thos pa slob gnyer/ mtshams bsnyen sgrub/ gnyis don du gar dbyangs thig gsum/ bca' 'bud brdung gsum rnams grwa ba'i 'gro lugs re bslabs na rang drin rang la che rgyu dang*/ yon tan rang la 'byar rgyu yin pas thos pa slob gnyer sbyang brtson byed mi yod na ci lcogs nged kyis bshad chog pa yin pas nges par gyis/ don tshan gsum pa bka' brgyad kyi sgrub mchod zla ba lnga ba'i tshes mgor dus nges can gyis yid nges thog nas spyi pa rnams kyis sngar nas cha ngag zhib sprod kyis/ yar 'du nyin par grwa zhabs tshang ma chad lhag med par 'du dgos/ ma 'dus tshe rgya gor gnyis kyi chad pa yin/ ༈ gzhi byes gnyis ka nas nges rgyur/ tshogs dus kun gyi thugs la bzung rgyu'i bca' bkod/ sgrub mchod dbu bzung nas mthar ma phyin bar du dge skos phyag gi bca' yig zur gsal ltar dang po tshogs khang gi sgo shub nas yar byon nas mar ma grol gyi rigs la/ bla ma dbu mdzad mchod dpon gsum sogs las sne pa rnams kyis skabs der dgos nges kyi brda sprod kyi gtam ma gtogs/ shog nyob kha phyes pa lta bu'i sab sob don med ngag 'khyal gyi lab gleng gi gtam ci dran gang dran bshad mi chog pa dang*/ gral nang bzhugs pa'i dus su lus mdun du sgur ba dang*/ g.yas g.yon sngas pa sogs ma yin pa'i bsam gtan gyis 'dug stangs dang ldan pa'i lus tshugs bsrang te gral gyi mdun ral gris bcad pa 'dra ba/

gral gyi rgyab a long 'thor ba lta bu las ci byung gang byung gis 'dug mi chog 2 cho ga gsungs pa'i dus su lo rgan pas gzhon pa/ che bas chung ba/ bla mas grwa ba rnams la zhal bsgos kyis skad ha cang che ba dang chung ba min pa'i gre ba'i nang nas rang babs kyi skad lhod la ldir ba zhig gtang mdzad de/ dal brel yang dbu mdzad la blta zhing de dang 'thun pa'i skad bsgrigs zhig las ra skad lug skad mtho dman sna tshogs dang*/ sngon rgyug rgyab 'then sogs ci mos gang mos 'don mi chog 2 rdo rje dril bu/ sgrigs rnga/ rol mo dang*/ dung chen/ rgya gling*/ dung dkar sogs yar len mar bzhag gang gi skabs na'ang kun gyis rang thob mnyam por 'bud khrol dang*/ dbu mdzad kyis sbub chol yang 'jam pa snyan la 'gyur ba/ zhi drag gi nyams phyed cing dal la skabs dod pa zhig gis rdor smin klong gsal so sor ma 'dres pa rang lugs dngos gtsang*/ seng chen kha 'tha'/ bya rgod gshog brdung*/ ce spyang seng skad sogs rang rang so so'i skabs ma nor ba zhig dgos/ dung chen pas 'dor rgyang ṇir 'bud rang skad ma 'dres shing rol mo'i sna 'dren la zhi drag so so'i nyams ldan dang*/ rkang gling pas bzhi 'bud/ lnga 'bud/ bdun 'bud sogs zin bris nang ltar ma nor ba dang*/ 'jam 'bol lhod pa'i rang skad dang*/ 'khyugs la 'dar zhing 'tsher ba'i phra skad dang*/ drag la ngar ba'i gdangs so so'i skabs thob dang*/ rgya gling bas spyan 'dren mchod pa sogs la snyan cing 'bud mi 'bud kyi rnam dbye yod pa zin bris nang ltar dang*/ rnga brdung bas zhi drag so so'i brdung lugs phyes nas/ zur gsum gtug lhod gsum phab/ ldir snyan brjid gsum tshang bas rgya mtsho'i klong mi dkrug ri rab gling bzhi'i mtha' mi bskor/ ri thang mtshams kyi brag mi bshigs pa sogs gnad tshang ba dang*/ rnga mi brdung dus rnga dbyug ngo glan/ rnga sa la bzhag dus sogs su lhod chags la 'jam po zhig las rgob chob 'ar 'ur seng 'khrol/

rogs dang mi 'grigs pa ci 'dod gang 'dod byed mi chog 2 mchod dpon rnams nas dkyil 'khor bshams bkod dang*/ mchod pa bca' rgyu/ mchod rdzas bkram pa/ mar me sbar rgyu/ mchod kha bsab rgyu/ mchod rdzas mchod skong rnams nyar tshag dam po byed rgyu las dka' 'tsher dang khag 'jog len byas pas mi 'ong*/ mchod pa bca' rgyu sogs la khag bsnyad de nam yin phyi rol 'gro ba sogs ci mos gang mos byed mi chog 2 khyad par dbu mdzad nas cho ga btang rgyu de ha cang yang mi brel/ ha cang yang mi dal bar tshig sngags gdangs phyag rgya rnams chad skyon med pa cho ga de dag tshar 'gro gnad smin zhig las tshar thabs mgyogs thabs kho nas zin bris sogs mi blta bar ci nyan gang nyan byed mi chog 2 ser sbreng sogs su byon skabs rgob chob 'ur sgra med par mgyogs thabs 'jam por byon cing de'i skabs su rtse zhwa gyon na thams cad kyis gyon pa lasa'aga' res gyon pa dang*/ 'ga' res phud pa sogs mi nyan cing*/ sgor bzhengs phyi rol grol ba'i dus su ral gri shub nas phyung ba lta bu/ nang du 'tshogs pa'i skabs ral gri shub du bsdu ba lta bu las 'gro dus rgyug mchong lag rtsed sogs gzhan ma dad pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba sogs mi rung ba dang*/ phyir byon pa'i skabs dang khyad par ser sbreng sogs kyi skabs mi gnyis re bar na sa 'dom gang re yod pa las/ gnyis gshib dang spung thabs su 'gro mi nyan pa dang*/ nyin gung rgyab dwangs sang chen po yun ring tsam las/ snga phyi dro'i tshogs bar rnams su yun thung ba tsam yin cing*/ nam yin tshogs rjes mi sleb cing*/ dbu mdzad kyi tshig mgo bskul dus mi sleb pa sogs ci shar gang shar de 'dra gtan nas byas mi chog pas/ de ltar dge 'dun spyi yi tshogs dus kyi mi chog bdun gyi bca' khrims 'di la gzigs mi dge skos rim gyis bskos rgyu 'di/ bla ma dgon pa grwa tshang yongs kyi spyi don/

steng gi bla ma/ 'og gi grwa tshang*/ yongs kyi spyi khrims/ bskos bzhag dge 'dun spyi yis mdzad/ de bskos pa'i mi rtsis bzhag gi rgyu mtshan/ legs byed bzang po'i dbugs dbyung gis gzengs bstod/ nyes byed ngan pa'i nyes pa chad las kyis phab mkhan dge skos bzhag nas 'dus pa'i khrims 'dus thog gi bshigs na mi gcig dang gnyis kyis bsnog rgyu med pa mi 'gyur ba'igatan tshigs kyi rgya ma 'di bstan pa dang sems can la lhag bsam rma med pa skyes bu dam pa tsho'i lugs srol red pas gzhi byes gnyis kas chos khrims kyi ngag la rtsi 'tsho dang lon yod dgos/ gal te mi nyan pa su yod na/ lung pa 'di la chu gcig 'bab pa de/ phu de na gangs gcig yod pa red/ gangs de la lha gcig yod pa red/ zer ba'i dpe ltar/ rgyab brten bla ma dang 'dus pa dge 'dun rnams kyi rgyab gnyer lhod med du yod nges yin pa go bar gyis/ de ltar mi chog bdun gyi bca' khrims dang mi 'gal bar byed na rang yang 'di phyir bde la skyid pa/ gzhan yang dga' zhing dang ba 'dren pa zhig kyang yin pas/ shes chen rnams nyams chung dang snyoms las byung*/ shes med rnams pho hob chog bzod byas nas/ ji skad du/ la la'i tshul khrims bde ba ste// la la'i tshul khrims sdug bsngal yin// tshul khrims ldan pa bde ba 'thob// tshul khrims 'chal ba sdug bsngal spyod// gsungs pa ltar lags pas mi ngan kha shas la sdug bsngal du song na'ang bzang po rtsis len dang*/ ngan pa gus 'ded la bskos pa'i mi dang btsugs pa'i shing la chos khrims zhes bzhag pa yin pas/ chos khrims kyis kyang rang khar bzhag thabs med cing*/ 'gal ba dang po la bsgo lab rten phyag lan gnyis pa la dran 'dzin gyi mar me/ lan gsum par dbyug pa'i chad pa rnams mi 'bul khag med/ dpon po'i bka' dang ri gzar rbab// bla ma'i bka' lung dge 'dun khrims// zer ba'i dper gyur pas/

mi mang sar sma phabs/ bya mang sar spu gtogs/ lta bu'i dper song na shin tu mi legs pa thams cad nas thugs bskyed rnam par dkar bas dge 'dun gyi spyi khrims rtsi 'tsho legs so zhig thub pa ci nas gsol ba lan stong du 'debs pa lags/ tshogs pa 'di'i steng nas tshogs ngan khong khro byed mi zhig yod na kha 'thab la mar me bcu/ lag 'dzing gtug na mar me nyer lnga/ rdo mtshon gnyis kyis 'dzang na go 'jo dge legs dang spyi ba rnams 'dzang dus kyi sngar gsho ltar ja bag drug drug gi chad pa zhu ngo sgron med yin/ ༈ don tshan bzhi pa rdzogs chen nas rab byung bsnyen rdzogs bsgrub rgyu'i thad nas sang phod sos thog tshun bco brgyad nas drug bcu'i bar sngar song zin gyi 'phros rnams rang 'khos kyi dge tshul slong gang mos kyi sdom pa len rgyu dang*/ blangs nas mar 'ong nas 'gag ring stod 'bog tsam gyi grwa chas mnab rgyu dang*/ mi kher rnams hor khog nas sgrub 'gro skabs phu dung can re 'gro 'dug de'i tshe chog rgyu ma gtogs/ sgrub mchaud sogs tshogs che chung gang gi skabs yin kyang bzang ngan ma ltos pa'i gzan sham sne tshang re nges par dgos/ ༈ don tshan lnga pa rta dbyangs gdangs gsum/ bca' 'bud brdung gsum/ sa bcad phyag len thig rdul mtshon rnams skabs su sbyang brtson ci nus kyis sbyang dgos pa dang*/ khyad par de nas 'di dang 'di dgos kyi cha gsal yod dus 'gor med dgongs pa thugs la bzhag dgos/ de ltar tshogs mchog dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde'i sgrigs lam nyams pa med pa'i thugs bskyed rab dkar dung dang zla ba dang gangs ri lta bur gong nas gong du 'phel ba las/ lus can ma lus pa'i bsod nams kyi zhing sa/ thub bstan rin po che phyogs brgyar 'phel la yun ring du rgyas pa dang*/ de 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa bshad sgrub las gsum gyi mnga' bdag bla ma dam pa rnams 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan/

mi 'gyur ba'i g.yung drung*/ mi shigs pa'i rdo rje ltar zhabs pad brtan cing mdzad pa phrin las rgyas pa las phan bde'i dngos kun yid bzhin lhug par 'jo ba dang*/ rang cag rnams kyang skye ba kun tu 7kun mkhyen padma rgyal pos rjes su 'dzin pa dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams su bde ba dang dge legs kyi dus ston rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i snang ba phrag brgyar rtag par 'byung ba'i rten 'brel gyi thugs bskyed dang*/ thugs smon yang dag pa'i mthun 'gyur rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas gnang bar zhu zhu// chos smra ba tshul khrims rgya mtshos bris pa dge legs 'phel/// /
